text:
Maria G.: Heads-up — plan to ship an opt-in 'Minimize PII' toggle in Route Dashboard for embedding and request logs. It will enable fuzzy redaction + HMAC fallback for sampled embeds. Requesting feedback before RFC.

Jin Park: Quick q — does this change sampling rate or only post-sample redaction? :thinking:

Maria G.: Only post-sample redaction + add metadata column 'pii_risk' so ops can tune sampler. Sampling stays controlled by quota policies.

Aaron L.: Concern: hashed embeddings still leak via similarity attacks. We need to ensure we never log raw embeddings even in ephemeral captures.

Priya S.: Agreed. Proposal: for embeddings, do immediate L2-normalize -> quantize -> HMAC with tenant key. Store only the HMAC and risk score.

Dee (SRE): Ops note — HMAC per-tenant keys will explode KMS calls. Suggest a cache for key handles and a fallback to a local ephemeral key for canary.

Maria G.: Good call. We'll add a key-handle cache TTL and metrics: kms.misses, cache.evictions, per-tenant-hmac-latency.

ops-bot: deploy-plan created: canary: route=/v1/embeddings/* percent=5 -> feature_flag=pii_minimize_toggle

Jin Park: UX: default OFF for all routes. Add a subtle "Enable for route" CTA in the Dashboard route settings + an inline tooltip explaining cost/visibility tradeoffs.

Priya S.: Also add a diagnostics column in telemetry: last_redaction_failure and sample_exposure_count. That helps debugging without exposing sensitive content.

Aaron L.: We should add an audit log entry (non-sensitive) when someone flips the toggle. Include who, route, before/after, and canary id.

Maria G.: Action items: I can prototype dashboard CTA + backend flag. Priya, can you mock telemetry fields? Dee/Aaron can review HMAC perf. Jin will write UX copy. Can we aim to canary next week?

Dee (SRE): I can do perf tests Wed. If HMAC latency > 20ms we need batching.

Priya S.: Mock telemetry JSON in thread:
```json
{"route":"/v1/embeddings/text","pii_risk":"low","redaction":"hmac-v1","sampled":true}
```

Jin Park: small nit — call the toggle 'Minimize PII (sampled captures only)'. Longer term we may rename.

Maria G.: Thanks all. I'll open RFC and link back here. :thumbsup:
